title: eis-task-manager daily format
description: How tasks are written in a daily note: the section, groups, task lines, date fields, priority marks and comments. Read and written by tasks-update and by the daily page. See daily-format.md.

format.description: Date as written in the note. Tokens YYYY, MM and DD, each once, with any separators.

heading.description: The whole line that opens the tasks section.

endsAt.description: A line that starts with any of these ends the section.

before.description: Text before the group name on its own line.

after.description: Text after the group name; may be empty.

default.description: Group for tasks with no team, project or topic; new tasks from the page go here.

open.description: Start of an open task line.

done.description: Starts of a done task line. The first one is written.

cancelled.description: Start of a cancelled task line; no cancelling when missing.

newPrefix.description: Prefix the brief puts on tasks new today; empty for none.

sourceSeparators.description: Text between the description and the source; the last one on the line counts.

created.description: Mark written before the creation date.

due.description: Mark written before the due date.

completed.description: Mark written before the completion date; added when a task is marked done.

ignore.description: Other date marks: kept in the line, hidden on the page.

indent.description: Indent written before a comment under a task.

prefix.description: Start of a comment line, after the indent.

line.description: The rest of the line. Must hold {text}; {date} is optional.

closedPrefixes.description: A comment that starts with one of these is the evidence that closed the task.

action.description: Marks at the start of a comment that is an instruction for tasks-act: waiting, being run, run, failed. No action comments when missing.
